title: Polynomial-order oscillations in geometric discrepancy
summary: Let $C\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ be a convex body, and for a positive integer $N$, let $\mathcal{P}$ be a configuration of $N$ points in $[0,1)^2$. The discrepancy of $\mathcal{P}$ with respect to $C$ is defined by \begin{equation*} \mathcal{D}(\mathcal{P},\, C)=\sum_{\mathbf{p}\in\mathcal{P}}\sum_{\mathbf{n}\in\mathbb{Z}^2}\mathbf{1}_C(\mathbf{p}+\mathbf{n})-N|C|, \end{equation*} and one may estimate how $\mathcal{P}$ deviates from uniformity by averaging the latter quantity over a family of sets.
